name: LiveRAG
description: LiveRAG is a publicly available dataset of 895 synthetic questions and answers designed to systematically evaluate Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) based Q&A systems. It includes ground-truth answers, supporting claims, and estimated difficulty and discriminability scores derived from competitor responses, enabling assessment of system capabilities across diverse difficulty levels.
reputation: A recent, specialized RAG evaluation dataset that is not yet widely adopted but is relevant for testing knowledge-grounded QA on synthetic, time-sensitive questions.
notes: Derived from the SIGIR'2025 LiveRAG Challenge; includes difficulty and discriminability scores using Item Response Theory.
